scope: Internal explicit EI seat binding and virtual device/region/keymap/modifier inventory with lifecycle generations. No input requests, parsed XKB behavior, physical-intervention or native-window/frame coordinate proof.

scoped_tests.coverage: 237-node main group on r2; runtime identical in r3. Final5-node check strengthens one existing FIFO case with four distinct map bodies and adds4 nodes. No main-group rerun after test-only additions. No full suite.

initial_results.resolution: Inspect final bytearray byte as integer, avoiding a strict-stub bytearray/bytes overlap diagnostic while retaining NUL validation. Added independent keymap bounds/thread tests; no assertions or timeouts relaxed.

profile_contract.entry: ControlSession.prepare_eis(with_devices=True) uses original once-only owned task/FD and exact system-requested device mask. Core default remains unchanged. Production worker and owner HTTP do not call this new profile yet.
profile_contract.selection: Read-only seats first, no default/first/seat-name or logind-label guess. Caller chooses exact current EI seat ID; bind exactly once. Actual server-assigned disjoint nonzero sparse capability masks determine bind value, only system-granted keyboard/pointer interfaces advertised.
profile_contract.metadata: Seat v1, virtual device v1/v2; bound interfaces only, unique increasing server IDs and bounded names. At most4 lifetime seats/devices and16 regions per device; finite positive scale, actual logical extents and optional v2 mapping IDs retained without screenshot/physical conversion. Byte/message budgets remain unchanged.
profile_contract.lifecycle: Actual serials handled with uint32 wrap and bounded forward relation. Newly advertised device paused; resume/pause/removal/interface removal/modifier notifications update immutable snapshots and epochs. Transient pause/resume cannot revive an expected old inventory. Receiver input events, reordered/late metadata and unknown interfaces fail proof.
profile_contract.availability: Inventory may record paused devices and missing optional keymap; that never grants input or proves concrete action capability. Sparse masks and announced interfaces, rather than a fixed keyboard/pointer mapping, remain authoritative.

keymap_contract.fd_queue: Default ReceivedFds pending/recv limit remains1. EI binding profile permits FIFO batch up to4, original lifetime limit4 retained; supports rights arriving before later device/keymap frames in a batch. Only keyboard binding window accepts rights; orphan remains unclaimed until original3s deadline then closes, no inventory publication.
keymap_contract.copy: Declared bytes and actual regular file size at most1MiB; bounded pread preserving shared offset, actual file identity/size/timestamps before/after, NUL terminator/no embedded NUL and UTF-8 validation. Retain original bytes/hash; no mmap SIGBUS path and no claim that text is syntactically/semantically valid XKB.
keymap_contract.lifetime: Original executor Future and shielded load task own actual FD. Caller or actual-task cancellation waits for real reader completion before close. Pending close keeps keymap/connection/Session ownership; completed close clears retained map body. No thread cancellation mistaken for stopped I/O.
keymap_contract.offline_evidence: Real temporary files and descriptors on Windows; explicit isolated pread shim where Windows lacks os.pread. FIFO checked with four distinct bodies/hashes, exact1MiB limit, partial reads, mutation/truncation/error, caller/task cancellation and retained FD tested. This is not Linux native execution.

publication: Local-only checkpoint; specific remote transfer authorization remains pending, no upload or push.
next: Parse/validate actual XKB behavior, EI emulation and separate-frame release receipts, compositor physical-intervention proof, actual target/region mapping, then single-use business dispatch and application readback. Entire V2 goal active; full suite after entire development freeze.
